name: Pathanamthitta
tagline: Pilgrim hills, temple rivers and the home of Aranmula
summary: Pathanamthitta: Kerala's pilgrimage district with Sabarimala, Aranmula's mirror and boat race, the Pamba river and Gavi forest tourism.

history.overview: The district was carved out in 1982 from Kollam and Alappuzha, but its history stretches back to the Pandalam royal family, Ayyappa legend and old Christian communities along the Pamba.

timeline.event: Pandalam and Aranmula emerge as temple and princely centres.
Pilgrim traffic to Sabarimala shapes the local economy.

unique: Sabarimala, among the largest annual pilgrimages
Aranmula's mirror, boat race and Vallasadya feast
Maramon Convention, a major Christian gathering

bestTime.why: Cool weather, pilgrimage season and clear Pamba river.
